name: goal
description: Read or steer this session's long-task goal. get returns the goal plus the goal_id and revision every other action needs. create starts one for a genuinely long objective, never for single-turn work. edit, pause, resume, complete and blocked act on the current goal and need goal_id and revision copied from a get. create, edit, pause and resume only run on a turn a human started; complete and blocked also run inside the goal's own automatic round, where blocked needs blocked_reason and is refused before the minimum consecutive round count.

goal_id.description: Exact id from get. Required by every action except get and create.

revision.description: Exact positive revision from get. Same requirement as goal_id.

objective.description: The concrete objective. Required with create, optional with edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Positive limit on automatic continuation rounds, for create and edit.

blocked_reason.description: Concrete blocking condition. Required with blocked.
